title: A Man A Mouse and A Shotgun
original_title: A Man A Mouse and A Shotgun
overview: A sleep-deprived man's morning routine takes a chaotic turn when he discovers an audacious little mouse has been stealing his coffee, food, and even his last cigarette. Frustrated and on edge, the man wages war against his tiny nemesis, escalating from simple traps to increasingly absurd extermination attempts. But every scheme backfires hilariously, leaving him more battered and desperate than before. As the mouse outsmarts him at every turn, the man spirals into obsession, ordering deadlier gadgets from a series of increasingly ominous websites. Will he ever reclaim his kitchen, or is he doomed to be outwitted by the ultimate tiny trickster?
